newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola Q2 worldwide case unit volume up.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola Q2 worldwide case unit volume up.

text.p: Coca-Cola Co said its unit case volume sales grew 7.0 percent in the second quarter.

The growth, as well as continuing strategies taken to strengthen its worldwide bottling system, helped boost the company's earnings per share in the latest quarter by 26 percent to $0.53, from $0.42 in the year-ago quarter, it said.
Worldwide unit case volume rose 8 percent in the first six months of the year, the beverage giant said.
Worldwide gallon shipments grew 9 percent in the second quarter and 8 percent for the year-to-date, it said.

For the latest quarter unit case valume rose 4 percent in North America, including 4 percent in the U.S., 11 percent in Latin America, 11 percent in the Middle and Far East, 7 percent in Africa and 5 percent in Greater Europe.
It said unit volume at its Minute Maid Co fell 6 percent due to discontinuation of non-from-concentrate orange juice products.
